verdict.rationale: Gumloop documents a public API reference covering authentication (API keys and OAuth 2.0), creating and updating agents, starting sessions with streaming output, and chat completions. Official Python and JavaScript SDKs and a public GitHub SDK repo back this up, which is enough to drive the product programmatically. Missing for 10: a machine-readable OpenAPI/Swagger spec (all probed paths returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of the API in real use.
